content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that the `s_fs_info` field of the `super_block` structure was being initialized too late in the `fuse_fill_super()` function, after the `super_block` had already been added to the `fs_supers` list. This resulted in a null pointer dereference when `fuse_test_super()` attempted to access `sb->s_fs_info`, which was still NULL at that point. The fix involved moving the initialization of `s_fs_info` to the `fuse_get_tree()` function, ensuring that it is set before the `super_block` is added to the list, thus preventing the null pointer dereference.
